parameters.jsonBody: ={{JSON.stringify({model:'gpt-4.1-mini',temperature:0,response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:'Extract a flight search request and return one JSON object only. Fields: origin_city, origin_iata, destination_city, destination_iata, departure_date (YYYY-MM-DD), return_date (YYYY-MM-DD or null), trip_type (one_way or round_trip), passengers (integer 1-9), cabin_class (economy, premium_economy, business, first), currency (3-letter code), max_price (number or null), direct_only (boolean), sort (price or recommended), user_language (ar or en). Understand Arabic route forms such as من إسطنبول إلى الدوحة and dates such as 15-10-2026 or 2026-10-15. Map common Arabic city names when certain: إسطنبول/Istanbul=IST, الدوحة/Doha=DOH, لندن/London=LON, باريس/Paris=PAR, الرياض/Riyadh=RUH, القاهرة/Cairo=CAI. Return dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Merge omitted fields from previous_context. Never invent an IATA code, date, or maximum price. If the user provides a callback action, preserve the route and dates from previous_context; callback filter actions are applied by the workflow.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({message:$json.user_text,action:$json.action,previous_context:$json.previous_context})}]})}}
